verdict.rationale: Pulumi's engine is open source, and its DIY backend keeps state in object storage you manage (S3, Azure Blob, GCS) instead of Pulumi Cloud. The pricing page says self-hosting is available, and a community user confirms the self-managed state option. One older community comment claimed Pulumi needs to call home and cannot run airgapped, but the documented DIY backend contradicts it, so it lowers confidence rather than creating a dispute. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on self-hosting the Pulumi Cloud service itself (only a one-line pricing mention), explicit airgapped/offline deployment guidance, and independent hands-on reports of a self-hosted setup.
